summary: Release: datasette-charts 0.2a1 Minor UI improvements: Collapsing the suggested charts section now leaves the chart visible. Following a link to a chart opens it with the suggestions collapsed for that visit.
takeaways: Following a link to a chart opens it with the suggestions collapsed for that visit.
On table pages the panel now sits below the "4,235 rows where country = CHN" line.
